answer: Use a micro-batch with a 10-second trigger over the existing order event log, running on the batch engine the team already operates. The glance cadence is about 1 minute, so the worst case (trigger plus batch run time) must stay well under 60 seconds, and 10 seconds meets that. A 1-minute trigger would push the worst case past the minute staff act on. Micro-batch also avoids a true always-on stream, which would need someone on call overnight, and the team has nobody. If finance totals are needed too, recompute them nightly as a batch from the same log (hybrid).
